name: Sei Cosplay Gakuen ~Game Bunkou~
original_name: 聖コスプレ学園 ～ゲーム分校～
source:
Popular Tokyo cosplay shop issues a game featuring itself. It's possible to work as a part-time worker there, build up relations with cosplayer girls, get into romance relations with them and even invite girls to school for some hot action! 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
东京一家知名cosplay店铺推出了一款以自己为主题的游戏。你可以在那里打工，与cosplay女孩们建立关系，和她们发展恋爱关系，甚至邀请女孩们到学校来一些火热的互动！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
